text:
**sqlpipe** is a command-line tool that syncs PostgreSQL tables to Amazon S3 as Parquet files. It reads rows from one or more tables, converts them to Parquet format, and uploads the files to a bucket you specify. You can run it on a schedule or as a one-time export.

The tool supports full and incremental syncs. In a full sync, it copies all rows. In an incremental sync, it copies only the rows that changed after the last run. sqlpipe uses a watermark column that you set to find new and updated rows. It keeps each output file small enough to process on a laptop or in a data pipeline.
